condition: sample_colorscale(colorscale, 1) and n_colors(low, high, 1) raise ZeroDivisionError when asked for exactly one color, e.g. a palette sized to a single group.
workaround: Handle the count==1 case separately, e.g. use the low color (or sample_colorscale(cs, [0.0])) when only one color is needed.
